leapable-mcp v2.2.224 - Document intelligence via MCP

Quick start:
  Download the signed Leapable installer for the no-prerequisite Bun sidecar.

Usage: leapable-mcp [command]

  (no command)       Run MCP stdio bridge (default — used by AI clients)
  install            Legacy npm wrapper install (retired on Windows/Linux)
  start              Start local HTTP service
  stop               Stop local service
  restart            Restart local service
  status             Show service health and endpoints
  logs [N]           Show last N lines of logs (default: 50)
  update             Update/verify runtime and restart
  config set K=V     Set a config value
  config get KEY     Get a config value
  config show        Show all config
  serve              Explicit stdio mode (same as no command)
  uninstall          Stop service (keeps local data)
  diagnose-port [P]  macOS only: list every process holding port P (default 4100)

Config keys: http_port, dashboard_port

One-liner for any MCP client:
  { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "leapable-mcp"] }
